And when on the road he quarreled with the envoy,

When they reached the camp of Möngke Khan,

And an order went forth
that the entire seed of the Ismailis, males and females, should be destroyed wherever they were.
And in that same year, Baiju Noyan, the commander of the army of the Tatars, went out towards Erzurum,
and he sent an envoy to Sultan Izz al-Din in the month of Ab,
and requested from him a place to spend the winter,
because in the region of Mughan,
in which he used to spend the winter every year,
Hulagu, the King of Kings, the brother of Möngke Khan, wished to spend the winter.
And with Baiju came King Hethum from his service to the Great Khan,
and entered his country on Friday, the first of Elul,
and there was rejoicing for the Christians.
The Sultan, however, was not willing to give winter quarters to Baiju and treated him with contempt,
because he had heard that another chief, who was greater than he,
or rather his lord, had expelled him from his country.
Therefore, he prepared for battle with him.
And when Baiju came,
Sultan Izz al-Din met him near Sultan Han between Iconium and Aksaray,
and was broken, and fled to his inland territories on the border of Nicaea.
The commander of the army of the Romans was Yawtash Beglerbeg,
who was also killed in this battle.
And Baiju Noyan brought Rukn al-Din out of prison,
and made him king over the land of the Romans in the year one thousand five hundred and sixty-seven

And Hulagu sent a yarligh,
that is to say, a decree,
that the territories should be divided between the two brothers.
Therefore, when the year one thousand five hundred and sixty-eight entered,
